Metadata for each set of samples collected at a given point in space and time. Each row generally refers to the sediment collected as the source material for the incubation experiment. The metadata file provides accompanying information captured in the field (i.e. coordinates; date; turbidity; water color; weather; etc.).
Step-by-step instructions used to complete the sampling in the field.

File that maps between sample names and registered International Generic Sample Numbers (IGSNs). Includes metadata required by Environmental System Science Data Infrastructure for a Virtual Ecosystem (ESS-DIVE) Reporting Format for Sample ID and Metadata (Damerow et al. 2020). Some fields are repeated from the field metadata. In compliance with the ESS-DIVE Location Metadata Reporting Format (Crystal-Ornelas et al. 2022) the Submission_Contact_Name; Submission_Contact_Email; Location_ID; Description; Latitude; and Longitude can all be found in the Dataset Metadata associated with this data package (and found on the ESS-DIVE landing page). The Location_ID; Latitude; and Longitude can also be found in this file as Locality; Latitude; and Longitude; respectively. There is no separate file associated with the ESS-DIVE Location Metadata Reporting Format.
Standard: ESS-DIVE Sample v1; ESS-DIVE CSV v1

File_Description: Sample metadata file containing sample names and experimental parameters for all samples. Each row represents a unique sample with associated categorical descriptors including material type, sampling conditions, experimental treatments, and analytical methods. This file functions as a sample inventory, connecting sample identifiers to their experimental conditions and enabling integration for analysis. Note that there are more samples listed than are included in this data package.

File_Description: Field moist sediment mass; dry sediment mass; water mass; and field moist sediment volume in incubation and sediment vials. The file follows the Environmental System Science Data Infrastructure for a Virtual Ecosystem (ESS-DIVE) Reporting Format for Soil; Sediment; and Water Chemistry data (Boye et al. 2022).

File_Description: Combined CoreMS calibration outputs (.cal files) across all sediment samples. This data is processed from .xml files.

Processed FTICR-MS mass-by-sample data from sediment extract samples. The first column contains calibrated masses. The following columns are samples. Each row is a peak intensity with values higher than zero indicating the peak is present in that sample. Use the "Calibrated_Mass" column to merge data with the mol files. This data is processed from .xml files.

Processed FTICR-MS data containing molecular information describing each mass value for both sediment and water samples in the files ending in "CoreMS_Processed_ICR_Data.csv". Use the "Calibrated_Mass" column to merge molecular properties with the data files. This data is processed from .xml files.

R markdown that combines CoreMS outputs (.corems.csv files) contained in a specified directory. Additionally, this markdown will run ftmsRanalysis to calculate additional molecular information and Song et al lambda calculation. See "Instructions_for_Processing_FTICR_Data_using_CoreMS.pdf" for more details.
Python script used to run the CoreMS workflow and generates CoreMS outputs. See "Instructions_for_Processing_FTICR_Data_using_CoreMS.pdf" for more details.
R script that formats files from CoreMS outputs into ESS-DIVE CSV reporting format compliant files. This script is provided for traceability.

R script for the lambda calculation from Song et al 2020 (https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2020.531756). Modified from https://github.com/hyunseobsong/lambda.
